entities.name: Mishra's Fortress
entities.description: Heavily fortified base Mishra built after the Fall of Kroog, a workshop and military stronghold in the Kher Ridges.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Builder of the fortress, whose industry is later corrupted by Phyrexian influence.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Phyrexian who manipulates Mishra and decides to corrupt him.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Group that brought Gix to the fortress.

entities.name: Kher Ridges
entities.description: Mountains of Terisiare where the fortress stands.

entities.name: Great Desert
entities.description: Arid land west of the fortress.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: Fallen city whose palace wreckage furnished Mishra's workshop.

entities.name: Fall of Kroog
entities.description: Event after which Mishra built his fortress.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War in which the fortress played a pivotal role.

entities.name: Siege of Sarinth
entities.description: Siege during which Gix came to the fortress.

entities.name: Tomakul
entities.description: Place Mishra planned to relocate his headquarters to.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: Stone that defends itself and its master.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Side Gix wants to bring Mishra over to.

events.summary: Mishra selects a site in the Kher Ridges and builds a fortress among great oaks, with a private workshop in a hollowed stump.
events.quote: Mishra had the stump hollowed out and converted into his private workshop

events.summary: During the siege of Sarinth the Brotherhood of Gix brings Gix to the fortress while Mishra plans to move his headquarters to Tomakul.
events.quote: Gix was brought by the Brotherhood of Gix to the fortress

events.summary: Gix finds he cannot murder Mishra and steal the Weakstone, and decides to corrupt Mishra for Phyrexia.
events.quote: Gix decided to corrupt Mishra and bring him over to the side of Phyrexia

relations.quote: the heavily fortified base constructed by Mishra
Positioned in the Kher Ridges of Terisiare
Gix found that he could not murder Mishra
